messages:
Jordan (Sales): Hey all  first week here. I don't have HubSpot edit rights, Dialpad number still pending, and can't find the latest SDR playbook or the sales one-pagers. Who should I ping for invites and collateral?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Jordan (Sales) to #sales! You've been added to the SDR cohort and assigned buddy: Alex. Check your inbox for the onboarding checklist.

Marta (Sales Ops): Welcome! HubSpot invite sent to jordan@redwood.ai and added you to 'SDR - Outbound'. Playbook + one-pagers: https://redwood.link/sdr-bundle (contains scripts, battle cards, and collateral).

Jordan (Sales): HubSpot invite accepted but I only see read-only on deals.

Chris (IT): @Jordan I bumped your HubSpot role to "Deal Editor" and re-synced SSO. Try a hard refresh or incognito. If you still see readonly paste the error.

Jordan (Sales): Editing works now, thanks. Dialpad still shows "invite pending" though.

Marta (Sales Ops): Resent Dialpad invite. If it doesn't accept in 10min I'll escalate to @Chris for manual provisioning. Did you want a direct DID or shared queue?

Jordan (Sales): Direct DID please, caller ID as "Redwood - SDR".

Chris (IT): Filed TEL-501 for a DID and enabled web softphone for you to start calling immediately. Dialpad invite accepted on our end; try logging in.

Jordan (Sales): Dialpad works now  can place calls and HubSpot logs show activity. One more: where's the handoff checklist for CS?

Eve (CS): @Jordan welcome! Handoff checklist here: https://redwood.link/cs-handoff (include qualification notes, demo recording, and tech stack). If you want a 10-min dry run before handing over ping me and I'll join.

Jordan (Sales): Appreciate it all  joining the 2pm shadow. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
